name: Radio / Model Quality
description: Model Quality product scenario for the Radio component.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Choices in navigation order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled selection; `null`, or a value missing from `items`, checks nothing.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial selection, restored by form reset.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Stacks the items in a column or a row and sets aria-orientation; all four arrows move either way.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the selected enabled item, else the first enabled one, on mount.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the group when there is no visible `label`.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of the elements that name the group; wins over `label` and `aria-label`.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables every item; native inputs leave the tab order and form submission.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of an external native form that owns every input.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each item; toggling it keeps the native inputs.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Nonempty native group and FormData key; use a distinct name for each independent group in a form.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require a selection before submission. Native group validation requires a nonempty name.
